_comment: Line relief via the orders queue (phase 3): a tired, thinned player infantry line holds an engaged enemy while a fresh unit waits behind it. The player box-selects the fresh unit and right-clicks the engaged friendly -- a RELIEF order: the fresh unit advances THROUGH its tired ally (the swap's pass-through exemption lives on the order) and takes over the fight, while the tired unit gets a queue-visible MOVE order and peels back to the rear. While the link is live both blocks widen their back-rank slot spacing so the reliever's front line can march between without intra-unit overlap. Record the movie at fixed_fps 60 so the step ticks line up with the 60/s headless state dump. TIMING IS LOad-BEARING: the right-click must land AFTER the enemy reaches the tired unit (contact is around tick 128), because a right-click on a friendly that is not yet fighting resolves to a plain ground MOVE instead of a RELIEF -- there is nothing to relieve yet. The reliever therefore starts close enough to complete the pass inside the clip.
